missing_evidence: Postgres server-side metrics (active/waiting connections, max_connections) to confirm pool saturation
Order service pool configuration and acquisition wait/queue metrics
candidates.statement: Postgres connection pool exhaustion in the order service: save_order spans show pool size 5 with 0 idle connections and fail with DependencyUnavailable, causing order POST /v1/orders to return 503 and gateway checkout to return 502 after ~2s.
candidates.uncertainty: Traces show pool idle=0 and DependencyUnavailable, but no direct Postgres saturation metrics were admitted.

report.explanation: Checkout 502s align with order-service failures: traces show postgres.save_order errors (DependencyUnavailable) with pool size 5 and 0 idle, propagating 503 from /v1/orders to gateway 502s at ~2s. Metrics confirm elevated /v1/checkout latency and 502 rate. Bounded candidate is db-pool-exhaustion; direct Postgres saturation metrics remain unconfirmed.
